Package simple.logging

Class LoggerUtils

java.lang.Object
simple.logging.LoggerUtils
public final class LoggerUtils extends Object
Utility class for managing logging configurations and handling log messages at different levels.

This class provides various methods for logging messages at different levels (INFO, WARNING, SEVERE, etc.). It also offers functionality to enable or disable logging, and it sets up handlers to log to both the console and a file (debug.log by default).

Log levels supported: - Level.INFO - Level.WARNING - Level.SEVERE - Level.CONFIG - Level.FINE - Level.FINER - Level.FINEST
